newsitem.title: USA: CME CATTLE AND PORK COMPLEX PRE-OPENING CALLS.
newsitem.headline: CME CATTLE AND PORK COMPLEX PRE-OPENING CALLS.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Reports of increased packer interest for fed cattle and boxed beef market appears to to bottoming.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Bullishly construed crop estimates for corn and index lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Mostly steady to lower cash hog indications and lower pork cutout values.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to 0.300 cent. Further weakness in fresh belly market.
